title: Engine Coolant Temperature Circuit Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: engine coolant temperature circuit low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates engine coolant temperature circuit low fault. The PCM compares coolant-temperature behaviour against expected warm-up curves and rationality versus other temperatures.

Closed-loop fuel control may be inhibited until the fault is resolved.
safetyImpact: Possible overheating risk; check coolant level before driving.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related sensors, harness, connectors, and components for damage, corrosion, or contamination.

fixSteps.title: Electrical/functional test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector; perform manufacturer-specific actuator/monitor test.

fixSteps.title: Replace component or perform service procedure
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component or perform required relearn and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes if temperature gauge reads normal; otherwise stop to avoid overheating.
No - the affected sensor or thermostat usually needs replacement.

Fluid level, condition, and the transmission cooler must all be inspected.
safetyImpact: Continued driving at over-temperature can destroy the transmission.

title: Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit Malfunction
shortDescription: PCM detected: cooling fan 1 control circuit malfunction fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates cooling fan 1 control circuit malfunction fault. The PCM commands the cooling fan and monitors current draw and feedback; mismatch between commanded and actual operation matures the code.

A/C cut-out and overheating warnings are common downstream effects.

safetyImpact: May enter reduced-power mode; merge with caution.

title: Mass or Volume Air Flow A Circuit Range/Performance Air Flow Too Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: mass or volume air flow a circuit range/performance air flow too low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates mass or volume air flow a circuit range/performance air flow too low fault. The PCM cross-checks MAP, MAF, throttle position, and engine RPM; persistent disagreement matures this rationality code.

Vacuum leaks and dirty MAF sensors are the most common root causes.
safetyImpact: May enter reduced-power mode; merge with caution.
